question: What is the symbol of the gene with id {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id}) RETURN g.symbol

question: What is the name of the disease with id {disease_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (d:`biolink:Disease` {id: $disease_id}) RETURN d.name

question: What is the description of phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id}) RETURN p.description
ground_truth: Ambiguous genitalia in an individual with XY genetic gender.

question: What is the name of the biological process {process_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess` {id: $process_id}) RETURN bp.name

question: What is the name of the pathway {pathway_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id}) RETURN pw.name

question: Which diseases are associated with the gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`) RETURN d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50

question: Which phenotypes are associated with gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature`) RETURN p.name ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 50

question: Which genes interact with gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:interacts_with`]->(g2:`biolink:Gene`) RETURN g2.symbol ORDER BY g2.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which pathways does gene {gene_id} participate in?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(pw:`biolink:Pathway`) RETURN pw.name ORDER BY pw.name LIMIT 50

question: Which biological processes involve gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess`) RETURN bp.name ORDER BY bp.name LIMIT 50
ground_truth: GABA synthesis, release, reuptake and degradation
MECP2 regulates transcription of genes involved in GABA signaling

question: Which phenotypes are associated with diseases caused by gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:causes`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature`) RETURN DISTINCT p.name ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 50

question: Which genes are associated with diseases that have phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id})<-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(d:`biolink:Disease`)<-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which variants are associated with gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (v:`biolink:SequenceVariant`)-[:`biolink:is_sequence_variant_of`]->(g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id}) RETURN v.id ORDER BY v.id LIMIT 50

question: Which diseases are caused by gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:causes`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`) RETURN d.name LIMIT 50
ground_truth: glycogen storage disease due to acid maltase deficiency, infantile onset

question: Which anatomical entities express gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:expressed_in`]->(a:`biolink:AnatomicalEntity`) RETURN a.name ORDER BY a.name LIMIT 50

question: Which diseases are associated with genes that interact with gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:interacts_with`]->(g2:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`) RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50

question: Which genes are involved in the pathway {pathway_id} and are associated with the disease {disease_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id})<-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:causes`|`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`|`biolink:associated_with_increased_likelihood_of`|`biolink:contributes_to`]-(d:`biolink:Disease` {id: $disease_id}) RETURN DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.name LIMIT 50

question: Which biological processes are linked to diseases caused by gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:causes`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_participant`]->(bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess`) RETURN DISTINCT bp.name ORDER BY bp.name LIMIT 50

question: Which genes are associated with phenotypes linked to disease {disease_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (d:`biolink:Disease` {id: $disease_id})-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature`)<-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which variants are linked to diseases associated with gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)<-[:`biolink:causes`]-(v:`biolink:SequenceVariant`) RETURN DISTINCT v.id ORDER BY v.id LIMIT 50

question: Which genes that participate in pathway {pathway_id} are associated with diseases that have phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id})<-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(d:`biolink:Disease`)<-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id}) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which diseases involve pathway {pathway_id} and have phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id})<-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id}) RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50

question: Which variants affect genes involved in pathway {pathway_id} and linked to disease {disease_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id})<-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)<-[:`biolink:is_sequence_variant_of`]-(v:`biolink:SequenceVariant`)-[:`biolink:causes`]->(d:`biolink:Disease` {id: $disease_id}) RETURN DISTINCT v.id ORDER BY v.id LIMIT 50

question: Which genes are linked to diseases involving biological process {process_id} and pathway {pathway_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess` {id: $process_id})<-[:`biolink:has_participant`]-(d:`biolink:Disease`)<-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id}) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which diseases have the phenotype {phenotype_id} and are associated with genes expressed in anatomical entity {anatomy_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (a:`biolink:AnatomicalEntity` {id: $anatomy_id})<-[:`biolink:expressed_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id}) RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50

question: Which genes participate in biological pathways {pathway_id} and are associated with diseases presenting the phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id})<-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id}) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which phenotypes are associated with genes interacting with gene {gene_id} and involved in pathway {pathway_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:interacts_with`]->(g2:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id}) MATCH (g2)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature`) RETURN DISTINCT p.name ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 50
ground_truth: Respiratory insufficiency due to muscle weakness

question: Which diseases are linked to variants affecting genes involved in biological process {process_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess` {id: $process_id})<-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)<-[:`biolink:is_sequence_variant_of`]-(v:`biolink:SequenceVariant`)-[:`biolink:causes`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`) RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50

question: Which genes participate in biological process {process_id} and are associated with diseases that share phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id})<-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(d:`biolink:Disease`)<-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess` {id: $process_id}) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which phenotypes are associated with genes affected by variant {variant_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (v:`biolink:SequenceVariant` {id: $variant_id})-[:`biolink:is_sequence_variant_of`]->(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature`) RETURN DISTINCT p.name ORDER BY p.name LIMIT 50

question: Which diseases share the same phenotypes as those associated with variant {variant_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (v:`biolink:SequenceVariant` {id: $variant_id})-[:`biolink:contributes_to`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature`)<-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(d:`biolink:Disease`) RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50

question: Which genes are associated with diseases linked to variant {variant_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (v:`biolink:SequenceVariant` {id: $variant_id})-[:`biolink:causes`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)<-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which pathways involve genes associated with disease {disease_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (d:`biolink:Disease` {id: $disease_id})<-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(pw:`biolink:Pathway`) RETURN DISTINCT pw.name ORDER BY pw.name LIMIT 50

question: Which biological processes involve genes associated with disease {disease_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (d:`biolink:Disease` {id: $disease_id})<-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:participates_in`]->(bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess`) RETURN DISTINCT bp.name ORDER BY bp.name LIMIT 50
ground_truth: Defective SLC9A6 causes  X-linked, syndromic mental retardation,, Christianson type (MRXSCH)

question: Which genes are linked to the disease {disease_id} or any of its subtypes?
cypher_template: MATCH (d:`biolink:Disease` {id: $disease_id})<-[:`biolink:subclass_of`*0..]-(dd:`biolink:Disease`)<-[:`biolink:causes`|`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`|`biolink:associated_with_increased_likelihood_of`|`biolink:contributes_to`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which pathways involve gene {gene_id} from clinical cases that present with the phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (hp:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id})<-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(c:`biolink:Case`)-[:`biolink:has_gene`]-(g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(pw:`biolink:Pathway`) ORDER BY pw.name RETURN DISTINCT pw.name
ground_truth: GABA synthesis, release, reuptake and degradation

question: Which diseases involve genes interacting with gene {gene_id} and associated with phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:interacts_with`]->(g2:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id}) RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50

question: Which diseases are modeled by mouse genotypes that share phenotypes with the mouse ortholog of the gene {gene_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (g:`biolink:Gene` {id: $gene_id})-[:`biolink:orthologous_to`]->(o:`biolink:Gene` {in_taxon:'NCBITaxon:10090'})-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(mp:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature`)<-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]-(:`biolink:Genotype`)-[:`biolink:model_of`]-(d:`biolink:Disease`) RETURN DISTINCT d.name ORDER BY d.name LIMIT 50
ground_truth: 3-methylglutaconic aciduria with deafness, encephalopathy, and Leigh-like syndrome
ADNP-related multiple congenital anomalies - intellectual disability - autism spectrum disorder

question: Which genes participate in the pathway {pathway_id} and are also associated with diseases that involve the biological process {process_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (pw:`biolink:Pathway` {id: $pathway_id})<-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_participant`]->(bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess` {id: $process_id}) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50

question: Which genes participate in biological process {process_id} and are associated with diseases that present phenotype {phenotype_id}?
cypher_template: MATCH (bp:`biolink:BiologicalProcess` {id: $process_id})<-[:`biolink:participates_in`]-(g:`biolink:Gene`)-[:`biolink:gene_associated_with_condition`]->(d:`biolink:Disease`)-[:`biolink:has_phenotype`]->(p:`biolink:PhenotypicFeature` {id: $phenotype_id}) RETURN DISTINCT g.symbol ORDER BY g.symbol LIMIT 50
